payload.subject: Re: Confirm visit
payload.body:
hi — thanks for the offer. can i check on the tuesday june 23 5:30 pm slot and get back to you? i want to confirm it works before locking it in.

if that time gets claimed in the meantime, no problem — just let me know what else is open.

thanks

value.rationale: No calendar or scheduling memory was available, so I held back from confirming the appointment and instead acknowledged the offer while keeping the slot in play.
